## GET /v1/apartments/property - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Apartments.com building in full by its link. Each building is a Place: `place.id` is the Apartments.com listing id, `place.name` the building name, `place.address` the full address, with coordinates, photos, the phone number and the listing link; `place.ext.listing` carries the lowest monthly rent (status for_rent, home type apartment), and `place.ext.apartments` the highest rent, availability, the lowest rent for each bedroom count, the current special and the amenities. Beds and baths stay null on the listing because each floor plan differs. The record adds the full description, every photo and the star rating with its count (`place.rating`, `place.reviews_count`) where the listing shows one.

**Use when** Use it with a building's link when you need its full description, every photo and its rating.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - An Apartments.com building link ending in its listing id, for example https://www.apartments.com/loyola-junction-i-austin-tx/940ms65/. · e.g. `https://www.apartments.com/loyola-junction-i-austin-tx/940ms65/`

**Response** `Place` object at `data`, `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/Place.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.description` | Description of the place. |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `place` {image_urls, latitude, longitude, phone, reviews_count}; `place.rating` {max, value}; `place.ext` {apartments, listing}. Never filled: `place.price_level`, `place.verified`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apartments/property" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.apartments.com/loyola-junction-i-austin-tx/940ms65/" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apartments/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the apartment buildings of an Apartments.com search link (url), a city, ZIP code or neighborhood page with any price, bedroom or amenity filters the link carries, 40 a page with the site's total. Each building is a Place: `place.id` is the Apartments.com listing id, `place.name` the building name, `place.address` the full address, with coordinates, photos, the phone number and the listing link; `place.ext.listing` carries the lowest monthly rent (status for_rent, home type apartment), and `place.ext.apartments` the highest rent, availability, the lowest rent for each bedroom count, the current special and the amenities. Beds and baths stay null on the listing because each floor plan differs. Pass the returned cursor for the next page. For the full description and every photo call GET /v1/apartments/property with the building's link.

**Use when** you want to compare an area's rents and specials from an Apartments.com search link, filters included.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 40/page · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/40) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `url` (optional, string) - An Apartments.com search link, for example https://www.apartments.com/austin-tx/ or https://www.apartments.com/austin-tx/2-bedrooms/. · e.g. `https://www.apartments.com/austin-tx/`
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-50) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages)

**Constraints**

- `url` is required (it is optional in shape only - the request needs it).

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.description` | Description of the place. |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `place` {image_urls, latitude, longitude, phone, reviews_count}; `place.rating` {max, value}; `place.ext` {apartments, listing}. Never filled: `place.price_level`, `place.verified`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apartments/search" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.apartments.com/austin-tx/" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
